correctness.rationale: At word length five, each identifying-code constraint is a closed-neighborhood or distinct-neighborhood symmetric-difference hitting clause (32+496=528 clauses). A complete include/exclude search with disjoint-unhit-clause feasibility pruning and no sampling independently excluded all codes of size <=11 and found exactly 58 size-12 masks; independently recomputed orbits (13x4,3x2), complementation fixed6, reversal fixed0 and eight never-selected vertices. Closed-neighborhood and labeled-word normalization checked; no extrapolation beyond 32 vertices.
